name: Hindu Hrudaysamrat Balasaheb Thackeray Maharashtra Samruddhi Mahamarg

timeline.event: First 520 km from Nagpur to Shirdi opens in December
Shirdi–Bharvir stretch opens, taking the open length to about 600 km
Final Igatpuri–Amane stretch opens on 5 June — all 701 km operational

history: The Samruddhi Mahamarg is a brand-new expressway built across Maharashtra to connect Nagpur, in the state's east, with Mumbai on the coast. Built by MSRDC and opened in stages from December 2022, its final stretch near Igatpuri opened in June 2025, making the full 701 km drivable. It has cut the Nagpur–Mumbai road journey from roughly 16 hours to about 8, and brings many farming districts of Vidarbha and Marathwada much closer to Mumbai's port and markets.
facts: India's longest fully operational expressway at 701 km (as of 2026).
Cuts the Nagpur–Mumbai drive from about 16 hours to about 8.
Designed for speeds up to 150 km/h — among the fastest roads in India.
Passes through 10 districts of Maharashtra, with interchanges serving Shirdi and the Lonar crater.
Includes twin tunnels of about 7.8 km through the Kasara ghat near Igatpuri, among Maharashtra's longest road tunnels.
